gh_dd334d63da583b7e89f279a6.description:
📍 Remote-first | ⏳ Contract 3 tháng
💰 40–45M
🌏 English working environment

Nếu bạn là ServiceNow Engineer/Developer có kinh nghiệm Security & Vulnerability Integration, đây là opportunity đáng cân nhắc 👇

🔎 WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

Develop & configure ServiceNow ITSM & CMDB
Custom Fields, Business Rules, Workflow Configuration
Build API integrations using REST API / SOAP API / IntegrationHub / Webhooks
Integrate security & vulnerability scanning tools with ServiceNow
Work with tools such as Tenable CNAPP / Tenable.io, Qualys hoặc cloud-native security tools
Bring security findings into ServiceNow and automate remediation ticket creation & assignment
Support the Vulnerability Management Lifecycle

🎯 REQUIREMENTS

2+ years hands-on ServiceNow experience
Strong experience with ITSM & CMDB
Hands-on experience with ServiceNow Integration / API
Experience integrating security/vulnerability tools with ServiceNow
Understand Vulnerability Management
Cloud knowledge: AWS / Azure / GCP
(Alibaba / Tencent / Huawei Cloud are also welcome)
English communication

⭐ NICE TO HAVE

ServiceNow CSA / CAD
Cloud / Security certifications
Experience with security scanning connectors/integrations
Enterprise / Financial Services / Public Sector projects, especially Greater China
